newsitem.title: UK: IBCA takes Costain off negative watch.
newsitem.headline: IBCA takes Costain off negative watch.

text.p: IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Wednesday it had removed the short-term C and long-term CCC ratings of Costain Group Plc from RatingWatch negative.
It said Costain was put on RatingWatch with negative implications in June this year when the company's shares were suspended due to the anticipated late publication of results for 1995.
Shortly afterwards, the group published worse than expected losses for the year, resulting in technical insolvency at the end of the 1995 financial year.
